visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A female dermatologist with short brown hair, wearing black-rimmed glasses and a brown textured sweater, speaks directly to the camera in a medium close-up shot. The background is a brightly lit, clean indoor setting with modern decor. (2) A sharp transition to an extreme close-up showing a medical laser treatment (UP Laser) being applied to a patient's reddened cheek. A transparent circular device is pressed against the skin during the procedure. (3) The scene shifts back to the dermatologist speaking, followed by a close-up of a face with visible acne scarring. (4) An informational graphic appears showing 'Juvelook' product boxes and a vial. This is followed by a cross-sectional animation of a needle injecting a substance into the deeper layers of the skin, forming a purple deposit. (5) A stylized cellular animation shows macrophages (green spheres) interacting with white powder particles, which then triggers the growth of purple collagen fibers within a network of pink skin cells. (6) The dermatologist continues her explanation, using hand gestures to emphasize the two-to-three-month timeline required for collagen production. (7) The video concludes with a static graphic displaying the clinic's logo, contact information, and addresses.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Logo]: DRX DERMATOLOGY CLINIC. [Subtitle]: 打完juvelook(膠原刺激物) 還能施打UP雷射嗎? (2) [Subtitle]: 第一個理由是因為他們的治療層是完全不一樣的 (3) [Subtitle]: UP雷射還是治療比較表淺的疤痕 (4) [Subtitle]: 那比較深層的疤痕例如說有一些凹陷 (5) [Subtitle]: UP雷射沒有辦法長出來的那種痘疤 (6) [Subtitle]: 反而是Juvelook打在比較深層地方 (7) [Subtitle]: 讓他那個地方長出膠原蛋白 (8) [Subtitle]: 接下來呢 Juvelook去長膠原蛋白這件事情 (9) [Subtitle]: 它並不發生在打雷射的這個當下 (10) [Subtitle]: 而是它需要一個大概兩三個月的時間 (11) [Subtitle]: 它才會慢慢的長出膠原蛋白 (12) [Subtitle]: Juvelook它是一個粉末狀的東西 (13) [Subtitle]: 這個粉末呢 它會被我們人體的巨噬細胞給吞噬 (14) [Subtitle]: 吞噬完之後 這個巨噬細胞會釋放長膠原蛋白的一些蛋白質 (15) [Subtitle]: 這個地方它才會慢慢慢慢的長出膠原蛋白 (16) [Subtitle]: 這件事情它需要好幾個月去發生 (17) [Subtitle]: 所以縱使你當下打下UP雷射 (18) [Subtitle]: 並不影響Juvelook的發生 (19) [Logo]: 美上美皮膚科診所 DRX DERMATOLOGY CLINIC. [Slogan]: 歡迎聯繫我們 contact us.
